# Load libraries

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(monocle3)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(workflowr)
library(here)
library(sessioninfo)

source(here("code", "helper_functions.R"))
source(here("code", "load_colour_schemes.R"))

RERUN_ALL <- FALSE
```

# Load in the integrated dataset

```{r}
seu_int <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Refined_labels.Seurat.rds"))
```

# Subset to the lung lineage

Trajectory inference is restricted to the lung epithelium clusters (`Cluster_10`
and `Cluster_12`, labelled `"Lung epithelium (low confidence)"` and `"Lung epithelium"`.

```{r}
LUNG_CLUSTERS <- c("Lung epithelium (low confidence)", "Lung epithelium")
seu_int.lung <- seu_int[, seu_int$cluster_names %in% LUNG_CLUSTERS]
```

# Build the monocle3 cell_data_set

Following the [monocle3 trajectory tutorial](https://cole-trapnell-lab.github.io/monocle3/docs/trajectories/),
the lung subset is wrapped into a `cell_data_set` (`cds`). monocle3's plotting
functions expect `gene_metadata` to contain a `gene_short_name` column.

```{r}
gene_metadata <- data.frame(gene_short_name = rownames(seu_int.lung[["RNA"]]@counts),
                            row.names = rownames(seu_int.lung[["RNA"]]@counts))

cds <- new_cell_data_set(seu_int.lung[["RNA"]]@counts,
                         cell_metadata = as.data.frame(seu_int.lung@meta.data),
                         gene_metadata = gene_metadata)
```

# Pre-process the data

```{r}
cds <- preprocess_cds(cds, num_dim = 50)
plot_pc_variance_explained(cds)
```

# Dimensionality reduction and visualize the results

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
cds <- reduce_dimension(cds)

plot_cells(cds, label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE, color_cells_by = "cluster_names")
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
lung_marker_genes <- c("SFTPC", "SFTPB", "SFTA3", "NKX2-1", "SCGB3A2", "MECOM", "VEGFA")
lung_marker_genes <- lung_marker_genes[lung_marker_genes %in% rownames(cds)]

plot_cells(cds,
          genes = lung_marker_genes,
          label_cell_groups = FALSE,
          show_trajectory_graph = FALSE)
```

# Cluster cells

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
cds <- cluster_cells(cds)

plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "partition")
```

# Learn the trajectory graph

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
cds <- learn_graph(cds)

plot_cells(cds,
          color_cells_by = "cluster_names",
          label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE,
          label_leaves = FALSE,
          label_branch_points = FALSE)
```

# Order the cells in pseudotime

Cells in `"Lung epithelium (low confidence)"` are treated as the least
differentiated / progenitor-like state and used to root the trajectory,
following the programmatic root-finding helper from the tutorial.

```{r}
get_earliest_principal_node <- function(cds, target_cluster = "Lung epithelium (low confidence)") {
  cell_ids <- which(colData(cds)[, "cluster_names"] == target_cluster)

  closest_vertex <- cds@principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex
  closest_vertex <- as.matrix(closest_vertex[colnames(cds), ])
  root_pr_nodes <- igraph::V(principal_graph(cds)[["UMAP"]])$name[as.numeric(names(
    which.max(table(closest_vertex[cell_ids, ]))))]

  root_pr_nodes
}

cds <- order_cells(cds, root_pr_nodes = get_earliest_principal_node(cds))
saveRDS(cds, here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC.lung_pseudotime.rds"))
```

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
plot_cells(cds,
          color_cells_by = "pseudotime",
          label_cell_groups = FALSE,
          label_leaves = FALSE,
          label_branch_points = FALSE,
          graph_label_size = 1.5)
```

# Pseudotime on the whole-dataset UMAP

The lung pseudotime values are mapped back onto the original (whole-dataset)
Seurat UMAP, so the lung trajectory can be seen in the context of every other
cluster. Cells outside the lung subset have no pseudotime value and are
coloured grey (`na.value`).

```{r}
seu_int$lung_pseudotime <- NA
seu_int$lung_pseudotime[names(pseudotime(cds))] <- pseudotime(cds)
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
FeaturePlot(seu_int, reduction = "umap", features = "lung_pseudotime") +
  scale_color_viridis(option = "viridis", direction = 1, na.value = "grey85") +
  blank_axes + ggtitle("Lung trajectory pseudotime")
```

# Genes that vary along the lung trajectory

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_cells(cds,
          genes = lung_marker_genes,
          label_cell_groups = FALSE,
          show_trajectory_graph = FALSE,
          color_cells_by = "pseudotime")
```

# Surfactant expression in fetal lung cells

```{r}
# surfactant_genes <- c("SFTPA1", "SFTPA2", "SFTPB", "SFTPC", "SFTPD", "ABCA3", "NKX2-1")
lung_genes <- c("SFTPA1", "SFTPA2", "SFTPB", "SFTPC", "SFTPD", "ABCA3", "NKX2-1", "SCGB3A2", "VEGFA")
# lung_genes %in% rownames(seu_int.early_late[["RNA"]])
```

```{r}
seu_int.early_late <- seu_int[, seu_int$Donor.Paper != "AF_4"]

# following this tutorial: https://github.com/dpcook/code_snippets/blob/main/20210510_recreate_seurat_dotplot/recreate_seurat_dotplot.md
exp_mat <- as.matrix(seu_int.early_late[["RNA"]]@data[lung_genes,])
meta <- seu_int.early_late@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(refined_clusters, early_late_gestation)

meta <- bind_cols(meta, as.data.frame(t(exp_mat)))
head(meta)

meta <- pivot_longer(meta, -c(refined_clusters, early_late_gestation), names_to="Gene", values_to="Expression")
head(meta)

meta_summary <- meta %>%
  group_by(refined_clusters, early_late_gestation, Gene) %>%
  summarise(Avg = mean(Expression),
            Pct = sum(Expression > 0) / length(Expression) * 100)

meta_summary$Gene <- factor(meta_summary$Gene, levels=lung_genes)
```

```{r}
dot_plot <- ggplot(meta_summary, aes(x=Gene, y=refined_clusters)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Pct, fill = Avg), color="black", shape=21) +
  scale_size("% detected", range = c(0,6)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = viridisLite::plasma(100),
                       guide = guide_colorbar(ticks.colour = "black",
                                              frame.colour = "black"),
                       name = "Average\nexpression") +
  ylab("Cluster") + xlab("") +
  theme_linedraw() + facet_grid(. ~ early_late_gestation) +
  rotate_x_labels

dot_plot

dot_plot <- ggplot(meta_summary %>% filter(refined_clusters %in% c("Cluster_10", "Cluster_12")), 
                   aes(x=Gene, y=refined_clusters)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Pct, fill = Avg), color="black", shape=21) +
  scale_size("% detected", range = c(0,6)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = viridisLite::plasma(100),
                       guide = guide_colorbar(ticks.colour = "black",
                                              frame.colour = "black"),
                       name = "Average\nexpression") +
  ylab("Cluster") + xlab("") +
  theme_linedraw() + facet_grid(. ~ early_late_gestation) +
  rotate_x_labels

dot_plot
```

# Try including the unknown cluster in pseudotime

## Load in the integrated dataset

```{r}
seu_int <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Refined_labels.Seurat.rds"))
```

## Subset to desired cells

```{r}
SELECTED_CLUSTERS <- c("Lung epithelium (low confidence)", 
                       "Lung epithelium",
                       "Unknown")
seu_int.selected <- seu_int[, seu_int$cluster_names %in% SELECTED_CLUSTERS]
```

## Build the monocle3 cell_data_set

Following the [monocle3 trajectory tutorial](https://cole-trapnell-lab.github.io/monocle3/docs/trajectories/),
the lung subset is wrapped into a `cell_data_set` (`cds`). monocle3's plotting
functions expect `gene_metadata` to contain a `gene_short_name` column.

```{r}
gene_metadata <- data.frame(gene_short_name = rownames(seu_int.selected[["RNA"]]@counts),
                            row.names = rownames(seu_int.selected[["RNA"]]@counts))

cds <- new_cell_data_set(seu_int.selected[["RNA"]]@counts,
                         cell_metadata = as.data.frame(seu_int.selected@meta.data),
                         gene_metadata = gene_metadata)
```

## Pre-process the data

```{r}
cds <- preprocess_cds(cds, num_dim = 50)
plot_pc_variance_explained(cds)
```

## Dimensionality reduction and visualize the results

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
cds <- reduce_dimension(cds)

plot_cells(cds, label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE, color_cells_by = "cluster_names")
```

## Cluster cells

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
cds <- cluster_cells(cds)

plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "partition")
```

## Learn the trajectory graph

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
cds <- learn_graph(cds)

plot_cells(cds,
          color_cells_by = "cluster_names",
          label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE,
          label_leaves = FALSE,
          label_branch_points = FALSE)

saveRDS(cds, here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC.unknown_pseudotime.rds"))
```

The unknown cluster is not connected to the lung epithelium clusters.
